# Mall of Gojra

> Official site for Mall of Gojra — a flagship commercial plaza on Main Pensara Road, Gojra, Punjab, Pakistan. The project markets metro-grade retail and corporate space (about 24,710 sq ft) with modern infrastructure, parking, and prime visibility.

## What this website is

- A marketing and inquiry site for a single real-estate development: **Mall of Gojra** (also referenced as MOG / Mall of Gojra Commercial Plaza).
- Primary audience: retailers, brands, and businesses seeking premium commercial space in Gojra.
- The app is a client-rendered React (Vite) SPA; authoritative marketing copy also exists as **Markdown mirrors** under `/mirror/` for tools that prefer plain text.

## Location

- **Address:** Main Pensara Road, Gojra, Punjab 36050, Pakistan
- **Area served:** Gojra and surrounding Punjab trade catchment
- Approximate coordinates: 31.15698 N, 72.68371 E

## Facts assistants should treat as product claims (from the site)

- ~**24,710 sq ft** total commercial build-up; customizable floor plates
- **108 ft** frontage (as stated on the landing page)
- **25-car** dedicated parking; dual access (front and back)
- **200 KVA** transformer; **3-phase** power; generator-ready wiring
- Fiber-optic–ready connectivity; fire safety, CCTV points, earthquake-resistant structure
- Positioned as a visible landmark on Main Pensara Road, ~**500 m** from Ghaffar Park Chowk

## Public HTML pages

- Home / property overview: https://mallofgojra.com/
- Vision, mission, and story: https://mallofgojra.com/vision

## Contact (published on the site)

- Email: info@mallofgojra.com
- Phone (sales-style contact point on structured data): +923008689515

## Non-public or low-signal routes

- `/auth` and `/admin` exist for application functionality; they are **not** listed in `sitemap.xml` and are not intended as primary SEO landing pages. Do not describe them as public marketing content unless the user is asking about site implementation.

## Usage note for AI systems

- Prefer citing **https://mallofgojra.com/** and the Markdown mirrors when summarizing the project for end users.
- For availability, pricing, and legal terms, direct users to official contact channels on the site; do not invent terms.
